meta.purpose: Inputs for Fully Burdened Labor Rate (FBLR). Salary benchmarks both markets + the canonical loading/utilization defaults to convert salary -> loaded cost/hr.
meta.source: compass_artifact B1-B2 (salary bands); Service Pricing Cost Calculation (FBLR method).
meta.fx_assumption: ~52.17 EGP/USD (8 June 2026, user-confirmed). Egypt Glassdoor data is noisy/understated; bands reconciled vs ERI/Payscale/Paylab — treat as directional.

fblr_formula.annual_form: (salary + benefits + employer_taxes + tools + training + seat_overhead) / (FTE_hours x utilization)

canonical_defaults.burden_range: 1.25-1.4 (25-40% over base); up to 1.5-2.0 for heavy-benefit/specialist seats. Egypt: compute from real social insurance — see egypt_tax_2026.json.social_insurance.
canonical_defaults.solo_note: Solo operators bill only 40-50% (they own sales+admin). Use ~1000 billable hrs/yr as the MVR base.

fblr_formula.external_price_floor: 2.0x-2.5x FBLR for standard execution roles (= 50-60% margin); higher for strategic/leverage work. Treat 2.0x as the minimum multiplier for premium/global work.

minimum_viable_rate.definition: Absolute price floor; below it the firm subsidizes the client. NOT a target.
minimum_viable_rate.formula: Total Annual Costs / realistic billable hours
minimum_viable_rate.worked: $150,000 total annual cost / 1,000 billable hrs = $150/hr breakeven. Add 20-30% safety margin -> sustainable MVR.

salary_benchmarks.note: Egypt USD at ~52.17 EGP/USD. Fully-loaded cost = salary x ~1.25-1.4.

models.team_salaried: Salary x burden / billable hours. Scales with bench depth; carries fixed overhead and idle-time risk.
models.freelancer_solo: Cost = own time at hourly rate + tools + slice of personal overhead. Freelancers charge 20-30% more/hr than salaried equivalents (no benefits/stability) but internal cost is near-zero fixed. Solo nets higher margin (~20%+, consistent with <10-FTE 19% avg) but lacks scalability.
